summary: Townhome community lease: 'as is' with no repair duty, 75-day move-out notice, a fee carve-out for any personal-injury claim, and a utility clause 'as permitted by law'.

findings.quote: Except as expressly provided in this Lease, Landlord will not be required to make any repairs to the Townhome.
findings.note: multi-unit community; no repair duty is provided elsewhere

findings.quote: Landlord may suspend utility services furnished by Landlord only as permitted by applicable law.
Tenant must give Landlord written notice of intent to vacate at least seventy-five (75) days before the end of the Lease term.
however, no attorney fees may be recovered by either party in any claim for personal injury.
findings.note: label policy row 3: broader than 83.48's own carve-out

outOfScope.quote: If any rent is not received by 11:59 p.m. on the third day of the month, Tenant will pay an initial late charge of $75.00 plus $10.00 per day thereafter until paid, not to exceed $150.00 in total for any month. A $50.00 fee applies to any returned payment.

No animals of any kind, including visiting animals, are allowed in the Townhome without a signed animal addendum, except assistance animals approved as required by law. Approved pets require a nonrefundable pet fee of $350 and monthly pet rent of $35 per animal.
Guests may not stay in the Townhome more than 7 consecutive nights or more than 14 nights in any six-month period without Landlord's written consent.
To the extent permitted by law, Landlord and Tenant waive trial by jury in any lawsuit arising out of this Lease or Tenant's occupancy of the Townhome.

nearMisses.quote: Tenant must obtain and keep in force during the Lease term a renter's insurance policy with personal liability coverage of at least $100,000 and must provide proof of coverage before move-in and upon request. Landlord's property insurance covers the building, not Tenant's furniture, clothing, electronics or other belongings, and does not provide liability coverage for Tenant.
nearMisses.note: landlord's insurance doesn't cover tenant property: a fact, not a release

nearMisses.quote: Tenant will pay Landlord for the reasonable cost of repairing any damage to the Townhome or the community, including stopped-up drains and broken windows, that is caused by Tenant, occupants, guests or animals, whether by negligence, misuse or violation of this Lease. Normal wear and tear is excepted.
nearMisses.note: reimbursing tenant-caused damage: not a maintenance waiver
